comments.author: DronMDF
comments.body:
Selfish miner can use some strategy

1. Found new block and wait until other found block. publich self block. Use time for mining next. This is look as optimal. (i can't realize this, miners not see other block in moment)
2. Found new block and wait until block time is over. Publish youself block, Use time for mining next.
3. Found new block, and mine next. If other found block. (in this architecture selfish miner cannot publish block in this time, but we can search for next block and publish next block faster. Longest chain win. 

third strategy is realizable.
